title: [Feature Request] Offset for first 24 hours on restarted G6 sensor
symptom: On a restarted G6 sensor, the first 24 hours of readings are consistently out by +2 mmol/l, which can cause closed loop systems to overdose insulin.
cause: The thread discusses that the offset is likely due to trauma compensation required for new sensors, but for restarted sensors it is not helpful. It is not a simple constant offset but likely a slow decay or logarithmic decrease.
fix: No fix was implemented. The maintainers advise against restarting G6 sensors and recommend calibrating after a restart instead of applying a fixed offset.
evidence_quote: The safest course of action is not to restart. If you choose to restart, the safest course of action is to calibrate.
